rics.meaning: China Retail Sales: Consumer Goods, Initial Release YoY — Reuters poll-anchored 'actual' release for surprise-vs-consensus tracking.
rics.how_to_use: Markets compare to Reuters consensus poll. Surprise drives Hong Kong + China A-share sentiment.

rics.how_to_use: Use alongside headline retail sales YoY (aCNRSLAR). Retail sales are the main consumer-spending proxy in Chinese macro data.

rics.description: Retail Sales, Consumer goods
rics.meaning: Retail Sales, Consumer Goods — level. Total retail trade (above-designated-size) value of goods sold.
rics.how_to_use: Use YoY (aCNRSLAR) for trend. Level useful for analytical baseline. Retail sales are a narrower measure than US-style retail since they exclude services.

rics.description: Retail Sales, Consumer goods, Chg Y/Y, National Bureau of Statistics of China
rics.meaning: Retail Sales of Consumer Goods, year-over-year change — headline retail print released monthly by NBS ~15th of each month with the broad activity bundle.
rics.how_to_use: THE China consumer-spending gauge. Pre-2018 ~9-10% YoY; post-COVID ~3-5% (sustained sub-5% reflects consumption weakness). Sub-3% YoY is recession-territory. Pair with consumer confidence (aCNCONCF) and online retail sales (aCNRSONLNR).

rics.how_to_use: Stable category. Tracks population + per-capita food spending. Useful as baseline for non-staples (durables, etc.) interpretation.

rics.description: Retail Sales, National online retail sales, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: National Online Retail Sales, YoY — pace of e-commerce sales growth. Tracks Alibaba (Taobao/Tmall), JD, Pinduoduo, Douyin commerce activity.
rics.how_to_use: Online share of total retail ~25-28% (vs ~16% US). Growth has slowed to single-digit YoY post-2022 as the e-commerce category matured. Tracks China's digital-economy share of GDP.

rics.description: Wholesale and Retail Trade, Tobacco and liquor, growth rate, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: Wholesale and Retail Trade: Tobacco and Liquor, growth rate — alcohol + tobacco sales. Cyclical with disposable income; baijiu (Chinese liquor) is a major category.
rics.how_to_use: Watch for premium-baijiu sales as a luxury-consumption indicator. Sustained drops in this category signal middle-class spending pullback. Anti-corruption campaigns historically depressed this category.

rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against the primary release. Use whichever has fresher data; methodology and timing differences across releases are typically minor and resolved on revision.
